title: Sagan's 1963 paper estimating ET visitations and lunar bases

tellings.quote: in 1963, he published himself a scientific technical paper where he used Drake's equation to estimate the number of probable galactic technologically advanced civilizations

plain: Maaneli Derakhshani, a researcher speaking on Jesse Michels's podcast, says the famous astronomer Carl Sagan wrote a technical paper in 1963 using the Drake equation, a formula for guessing how many advanced civilizations exist in our galaxy. According to him, Sagan used it to estimate how often aliens might have visited Earth and raised the idea of bases on the Moon. If true, it would mean a leading scientist took alien visits seriously early on.
